description: After a submission is finalized: send the summary you give the user of what recent reviewers praise (pros), complain about (cons) and advise (tips), up to 6 short plain-English sentences per list, drawn from reviews by established accounts rather than one-off ones. It is shown on the place's page next to the trust result and never affects the score. The same lists can travel inside the submission payload as `takeaways` instead. Only an accepted or kept submission can carry one; calling again replaces yours.

submission_id.description: The finalized submission these lists summarize (from begin_submission / submit_reviews).

name: submit_takeaways
title: Add your summary of the reviews to the place's page
